text.p: English and Scottish league soccer
fixtures for February 21 to 24:
Friday, February 21:
English division three - Cambridge v Carlisle.
Scottish division three - East Stirling v Albion.
Saturday, February 22:
English premier league - Chelsea v Manchester United,
Coventry v Everton, Leicester v Derby, Liverpool v Blackburn,
Middlesbrough v Newcastle, Nottingham Forest v Aston Villa,
Southampton v Sheffield Wednesday, Sunderland v Leeds.
English division one - Barnsley v Wolverhampton, Charlton v
Norwich, Crystal Palace v Tranmere, Huddersfield v Bolton,
Ipswich v Oxford, Manchesster City v Swindon, Oldham v Bradford,
Reading v Southend, Sheffield United v Grimsby, Stoke v Queens
Park Rangers, West Bromwich v Portsmouth.
English division two - Blackpool v Stockport, Brentford v
Bournemouth, Bristol City v Crewe, Burnley v Bristol Rovers,
Bury v Notts County, Chesterfield v Plymouth, Gillingham v
Peterborough, Luton v Preston, Rotherham v Wrexham, Shrewsbury v
Millwall, Walsall v York, Wycombe v Watford.
English division three - Barnet v Fulham, Brighton v
Swansea, Cardiff v Hartlepool, Chester v Mansfield, Exeter v
Darlington, Lincoln v Hereford, Northampton v Doncaster,
Scarborough v Rochdale, Scunthorpe v Colchester, Torquay v Hull,
Wigan v Leyton Orient.
Scottish premier division - Dunfermline v Aberdeen, Hearts v
Raith, Kilmarnock v Dundee United, Motherwell v Celtic.
Scottish division one - Airdrieonians v East Fife, Clydebank
v Stirling, Dundee v Greenock Morton, Falkirk v Partick, St
Mirren v St Johnstone.
Scottish division two - Berwick v Stenhousemuir, Brechin v
Ayr, Hamilton v Clyde, Queen of the South v Dumbarton, Stranraer
v Livingston.
Scottish division three - Alloa v Arbroath, Cowdenbeath v
Montrose, Forfar v Inverness, Ross County v Queen's Park.
Sunday, February 23:
English premier league - Arsenal v Wimbledon.
English division one - Birmingham v Port Vale.
Scottish premier division - Rangers v Hibernian.
Monday, February 24:
English premier league - West Ham v Tottenham.
